home.heading: The Schrödinger equation, made visible.
home.intro: A pedagogical platform for physics, blending clearly written course notes with simulations you can tune and watch evolve in real time.

read.title: Read the theory
read.desc: Typeset course notes with real LaTeX — the physics stays front and center.

tune.title: Tune the parameters
tune.desc: Drag sliders and watch the potential and its eigenstates reshape instantly.

watch.title: Watch it evolve
watch.desc: Stream a wavepacket in real time and scrub through its evolution frame by frame.

index.heading: Quantum mechanics
index.intro: Eigenstates, wavepackets, and the geometry of solutions to the Schrödinger equation.
index.readingOrder: The modules are numbered in a suggested reading order, but each one stands on its own — select tags to narrow the list.

schrodinger.title: The Schrödinger equation
schrodinger.summary: The evolution postulate, and why everything reduces to an eigenvalue problem.

measurement.title: Measurement
measurement.summary: The measurement postulate: possible outcomes, the Born rule, wavefunction collapse — and why the operator has to be Hermitian.

maser.title: The ammonia maser
maser.summary: A two-level Hamiltonian with off-diagonal coupling: symmetric and antisymmetric states, the tunneling oscillation between them, and how it becomes a maser.

wavefunctions.title: The wavefunction
wavefunctions.summary: What is the wavefunction? How do we define it in position and momentum space, and how do we interpret it?

harmonic.title: Harmonic oscillator
harmonic.summary: Quantised energy levels and the zero-point energy.

barrier.title: Tunneling through a barrier
barrier.summary: Transmission and reflection at a finite potential step.

well-bound-states.title: Bound states of the finite well
well-bound-states.summary: Parity, the graphical construction, and how many states a well holds.

well-2d.title: Particle in a 2D well
well-2d.summary: Separable states, and degeneracy as lattice points on an ellipse.

orbitals.title: Atomic orbitals
orbitals.summary: 3D electron density of hydrogen-like states, in spherical coordinates.

spin.title: Spin measurement
spin.summary: Successive measurements, collapse, and the Bloch sphere.
